column1: # shards.tsv — the langspec corpus split into CI shards, one line per
# (shards_test.go) keeps it complete and disjoint; `make test-langspec
# SHARD=n` runs one shard and the ci.yml matrix runs them in parallel.
# Tests that share a memoised walk (gatherCensus: TestCompiledCoverage,
# two TestSpecProd*) stay together so the walk runs once. Balanced greedily
# on each test's wall clock with the parallel corpus walk on four cores,
# one test at a time (`go test ./langspec -v -parallel 1`, 2026-09-18:
# about 140 s per shard, which the shard's own t.Parallel() overlap and a
# CI runner bring under the three-minute ceiling with its setup); the
# eight-way split is what the ceiling needs, not a preference. Rebalance
# when one shard drifts past the others by more than a minute.
